Versions of
The Road Not Taken
by Robert Frost
→
  • related portals: American literature
  • sister projects: Wikipedia article, Commons category, Wikidata item

Originally published in 1915, but revised in the 1916 edition of Mountain Interval.

3687386The Road Not TakenRobert Frost
Versions of The Road Not Taken include:
  • "The Road Not Taken", from Mountain Interval (1916, rev. 1920)
  • "The Road Not Taken", from Collected Poems of Robert Frost (1930)


This work is in the public domain in the United States because it was published before January 1, 1931.

The longest-living author of this work died in 1963, so this work is in the public domain in countries and areas where the copyright term is the author's life plus 62 years or less. This work may be in the public domain in countries and areas with longer native copyright terms that apply the rule of the shorter term to foreign works.
